d: Patna men bankipur part-2! 30 sal purana BJP ka garh dhahane vale kaun hain do. sanjiv kumar sinh?patna shikshak vidhan parishad (MLC) sit par is bar vo bara ulatpher ho gaya, jiski kisi ne kalpana bhi nahin ki thi. bhajpa ka 30 sal purana garh aur lagatar 5 bar se vidhan parshad rahe diggaj neta naval kishor yadav ka varchasv aakhirkar tut gaya. is aitihasik kile ko dhahaya hai 'doktar sahab' ke nam se mashhur do. sanjiv kumar sinh ne, jinhonne 1,057 maton se bari jit hasil ki! bankipur ke siyasi samikarnon ki tarj par do. sanjiv sinh ne sirph RJD ke paranprik vot baink ko hi nahin sadha,…
